_readme: Career track. 'levels' are the Healthcare IT career levels (XP thresholds). Each role has 'atLevel' (index into levels) – the point on the career map where that branch opens. Skill points come from completed lessons ('skills' in each module); 'german' comes from German study hours; 'business' starts with the degree baseline. Salaries are indicative annual gross CHF – verify.

levels.name: Admin Rookie
levels.meaning: You know the patient journey and the words behind it.

levels.name: Process Specialist
levels.meaning: You can explain each step, who does it and what goes wrong.

levels.name: Revenue Cycle Analyst
levels.meaning: You trace rejections to their root cause and talk in KPIs.

levels.name: Business Analyst
levels.meaning: You turn problems into requirements, stories and process models.

levels.name: IS-H / Epic Analyst
levels.meaning: You connect process, tables and modules in both worlds.

levels.name: Healthcare IT Expert
levels.meaning: You lead change across clinic, finance and IT.

salaryVerify.note: Salary ranges are indicative for Swiss hospitals and consultancies and vary by region, seniority and employer. Check current data before negotiating.

roles.title: Process Manager Order-to-Cash (healthcare)
tasks: Own the revenue cycle from referral to payment
Define and track KPIs (rejection rate ≤ 3 %, days sales outstanding)
Drive root-cause fixes across admission, coding and billing
roles.asset: The most business-heavy role: finance, KPIs, process ownership. Your degree is a direct qualification here.

roles.title: Business Analyst / Product Owner (hospital IT or revenue cycle)
tasks: Elicit and document requirements with clinics, finance and IT
Model as-is and to-be processes in BPMN
Own and refine the backlog, run sprint reviews
Accept deliveries and measure their value
certs: Scrum.org PSPO I or Scrum Alliance CSPO
roles.asset: BA and PO roles are business roles first. Your Master's gives you structured thinking, business cases and the language of management.

roles.title: SAP IS-H Application Manager / Consultant
tasks: Run and support IS-H patient management and patient accounting
Analyse incidents, customize, test and transport changes
Implement tariff changes (TARDOC, SwissDRG versions) in the system
Support migration projects: data mapping, parallel run
roles.asset: Your business degree helps you see why patient accounting matters: you can talk revenue, cost and process with finance, not only settings.

roles.title: Epic Application Analyst (Prelude / Cadence / Resolute)
tasks: Build and maintain Epic registration, scheduling or billing
Work queues, reports and continuous improvement
certs: Epic certification – only through employer sponsorship (e.g. Prelude, Cadence, Resolute HB/PB)
roles.asset: Epic hires analysts from the business side. Your degree plus Swiss process knowledge is what hospitals need to configure Epic for Swiss tariffs and insurers.
